events.description: The No. 13 Oregon Ducks visit the Michigan State Spartans for an NCAA Division I FBS game. Oregon rides a three-game win streak with Dylan Raiola, while Michigan State lost 21-14 to Washington on Nov. 14 with Alessio Milivojevic in the Big Ten. (Sports, Series) - 20261121
